about: End-to-end evaluation set for JobPilot. 8 job descriptions x 4 fictional resumes, 18 pairs. Labelled by hand before running the agent: each JD's must-have skills (canonical names from jobpilot/skills.py), each resume's real skills, and whether a careful recruiter would tell this candidate to apply. All companies' JDs are written for this eval; all people are fictional. The 'holdout' block (2 more JDs, 1 more resume, 6 pairs) was written after the rule fixes and is reported separately; rules are not tuned on it.

ai_engineer.text:
AI Engineer (GenAI) — Bengaluru
About the role: You'll build LLM-powered agents that automate merchant support and onboarding.

What you'll do:
- Design and ship AI agents using LangChain and LangGraph
- Build RAG pipelines over internal docs with a vector database
- Expose models through FastAPI services and deploy them with Docker on AWS
- Set up LLM evaluation for accuracy and hallucination

Requirements:
- Strong Python and SQL
- Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering and RAG
- Experience with LangChain or LangGraph and building AI agents

Nice to have:
